Source The drama inside the Bigg Boss 20 house is getting intense among the contestants. In a recent episode, Manish Goel and singer Qazi Touqeer had a clash after the singer called him "Professor." Manish lost his temper over being teased with names like "Professor." Manish's wife, Poonam Narula, has come forward to support him.
 Poonam Narula wrote on the photo-sharing app, “Ever since Manish entered the house, Qazi has constantly poked him with names like Gyani Baba and Professor. It initially started as a prank played by Qazi, where other housemates also joined in. Manish had no idea about it, but he still took it sportingly. However, Qazi kept taking it further with condescending remarks and age-shaming. When Manish finally asked him to stop and draw a line, Qazi told the camera that he would make Manish cry and wouldn't stop. That is the real reason behind Manish's reaction to the word Professor."
 She added, “My husband never approaches Qazi to pick a fight. He doesn't care about screen time. If he did, he would have done things purely for footage, but he doesn't. He is emotional, sometimes dramatic, and speaks in strong words. He is a North Indian man born in the 70s. That is his personality. Just because the younger generation may not relate to his way of speaking or reacting doesn't mean he is pretending. He is a genuinely nice family man, but he will react when someone constantly pokes him, age-shames him, or makes inappropriate poop jokes around him. That is simply not his class.”
